output.title: Renovated 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
This spacious 220 m² penthouse, located in the upscale Belair neighborhood, offers a refined urban living experience complemented by green surroundings. The apartment features four bedrooms and three bathrooms, including a master suite with direct access to a private terrace, enhancing its connection to outdoor space.

The living area is bright and airy, characterized by floor-to-ceiling windows that frame panoramic views of Luxembourg City. Newly renovated, it combines oak parquet flooring with a wood-burning fireplace, presenting a harmonious blend of contemporary style and comfort. Integrated smart-home lighting contributes to the sophisticated atmosphere.

The kitchen is designed for both functionality and elegance, equipped with Gaggenau appliances and featuring a Carrara marble island alongside matte black fixtures. A built-in wine fridge adds to the appeal, making it suitable for entertaining or culinary pursuits.

An expansive, south-facing terrace offers 180-degree unobstructed city views, fitted with composite decking and a glass balustrade. The outdoor lounge area adds to the living space, ideal for relaxation and social gatherings.

Additional amenities include elevator access, parking, and a cellar, providing convenience and storage within the building. Positioned in a quiet, green part of Belair, the property balances urban proximity with a tranquil environment.

highlights.text: 220 m² renovated penthouse with 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms
Panoramic 180-degree city views from living area and terrace
Gaggenau appliances and Carrara marble island in kitchen
South-facing terrace with composite decking and outdoor lounge
Floor-to-ceiling windows with oak parquet and wood-burning fireplace
Private master suite terrace access and walk-in closet
Building amenities include elevator, parking, and cellar storage
